title: Arrearage Management Program — Energy Assistance Pledge Window
content:
# Arrearage Management Program — Energy Assistance Pledge Window

**Rule.** For a program bill of an Arrearage Management Program plan, the forgiveness kind of Payment Arrangement, an energy assistance agency's pledge on the agreement is on record when an earlier payment from an energy assistance agency was posted to the Electric Service Agreement within the agency pledge window before booking. The agency pledge window is:

- **12 months** when the plan carries no earlier missed-installment entry and the Electric Service Agreement's start date lies at least 120 whole calendar months before booking;
- **6 months** when exactly one of those two holds;
- **zero months**, so that no booking-day agency payment is recognised, when neither holds.

A window of a number of months before booking covers payments dated after the same calendar day that many months earlier, up to and including the booking date. Months between the start date and the booking day are counted in whole calendar months.

## Truth table

| No earlier missed-installment entry on the plan | Start date at least 120 whole calendar months before booking | Agency pledge window |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | 12 months |
| Yes | No | 6 months |
| No | Yes | 6 months |
| No | No | 0 months |

## Hypothetical reading

An agreement in service since 2012 carries a program plan with one earlier missed-installment entry; an agency paid on the agreement 4 months before booking. Exactly one condition holds, so the window is 6 months, and the payment 4 months back lies inside it.
